'''Gojō Tenjin Shrine''' (五條天神社 or 五条天神社) refers to Shinto shrines. As religious corporations, there are two entities: one registered as "五條天神社" and another as "五条天神社."

* {{ill|Gojō Tenjin Shrine (Taitō-ku)|ja|五條天神社 (台東区)|1=Gojo Tenjin Shrine (Tokyo)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojō Tenjin Shrine (Taitō-ku)|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojo Tenjin Shrine (Tokyo)|qq=}} - Located in {{ill|Ueno Park|en|Ueno Park|qid=Q746216|lt=Ueno Park|1=Ueno Park}}, {{ill|Taitō|en|Taitō|qid=Q232641|lt=Taitō, Tokyo|1=Taitō}}, {{ill|Tokyo|en|Tokyo|qid=Q1490|lt=Tokyo|1=Tokyo}}.
* {{ill|Gojō Tenjin-gū|ja|五條天神社 (京都市)|1=Gojō Tenjin-gū|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojō Tenjin-gū|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojō Tenjin-gū|qq=}} - Located in {{ill|Shimogyō-ku, Kyoto|en|Shimogyō-ku, Kyoto|qid=Q1077022|lt=Shimogyō-ku|1=Shimogyō-ku, Kyoto}}, {{ill|Kyoto|en|Kyoto|qid=Q34600|lt=Kyoto|1=Kyoto}}, {{ill|Kyoto Prefecture|en|Kyoto Prefecture|qid=Q120730|lt=Kyoto Prefecture|1=Kyoto Prefecture}}. Its registered name as a religious corporation uses the modern form, "五条天神社."

* {{ill|Gojōzan Tenjin Shrine|ja|五條山天神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gojōzan Tenjin Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135504364|1=Gojōzan Tenjin Shrine}} - Located in Akabanechō, Nara City, Nara Prefecture.
* {{ill|Goryō Tenjin Shrine|ja|五霊天神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Goryō Tenjin Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135504369|1=Goryō Tenjin Shrine}} - Located in Hanada-chō, Himeji City, Hyōgo Prefecture. The registered name as a religious corporation uses the traditional kanji, "五靈天神社."
